findings.confidence: high; no OS signal-sender audit was available
findings.evidence: Legacy starts 2026-09-09T01:34:04.623Z; native exits approximately 77 ms later. Installed legacy ensureLlamaCppServer evicts healthy same-model listener when its persisted args/PID record cannot match. User confirms opening legacy alongside native. Subsequent native prompt fails Conflict while legacy still listens; next successful prompt loads a fresh native runtime.

Live /proc argv matches preserved 35B profile tuning; live executable bytes match pinned executable SHA. Profile hash unchanged. No stock backend substitution. Historical exact legacy process environment was not retained.
